user.title: Connect Liftosaur
user.description: Create an API key in the Liftosaur app under Settings → API Keys (needs Liftosaur Premium). It starts with lftsk_.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your Liftosaur API key
reauth_confirm.description: Liftosaur rejected the saved API key. Create a new one under Settings → API Keys.

error.no_subscription: The Liftosaur API needs an active premium subscription.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.

data_description.dashboards: Leave empty to include every dashboard, including ones you add later.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to re-evaluate your dashboards outside the workout window.
data_description.backfill_weeks: How far back to fill in charts when a sensor first appears. 0 turns backfill off.
data_description.workout_window: Check Liftosaur far more often during your usual training time, so sensors (and automations like PR alerts) update minutes after you finish a workout.
data_description.workout_start: Local time. The window can cross midnight.
data_description.workout_interval: In the window each check is one small request; dashboards are re-evaluated only when a workout was added or changed.

error.invalid_auth: Liftosaur rejected the saved API key.
error.no_subscription: The Liftosaur API needs an active premium subscription.
error.window_empty: The window must start and end at different times.

backfill.name: Backfill history
backfill.description: Re-evaluate every Liftosaur sensor's history and write it into long-term statistics. Use it after editing a dashboard or changing the backfill depth.

config_entry_id.name: Liftosaur account
config_entry_id.description: Only this account. Leave empty for all.
